Anonymous, The Life of Lazarillo de Tormes, translated by Clements Markham.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anonymous/the-life-of-lazarillo-de-tormes/clements-markham

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anonymous, the author: no death year, because the work is anonymous.
- Clements Markham, the translator, annotator and writer of the introduction or preface, died 1916 (Wikidata Q507802, P570 1916-01-30 and 1916-01-01).

First publication of the text used: 1908, the English translation by Clements Markham. The Spanish original was published in 1554. The country of first publication of the translation is not stated in the facts. (SE colophon: 'The Life of Lazarillo de Tormes was published in 1554. It was translated from Spanish in 1908 by Clements Markham.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the translation was first published in 1908 and the original in 1554, both before 1931, so the text is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement quoted below says the same.
- Country of origin: Every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (Clements Markham, the translator, died 1916), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The country of first publication does not matter. The original is an anonymous Spanish work published in 1554, before 1800, so it is public domain in every country whatever its country of origin.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon of this edition (https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anonymous/the-life-of-lazarillo-de-tormes/clements-markham): quoted above.
- Wikidata Q507802 (Clements Markham), P570 1916-01-30 and 1916-01-01.
